groups.boundary_rationale: The narrator introduces regular worship and the fourfold classification being explained.
Two supported forms: inward image worship and one-self contemplation, with the reason both have an explicit support.
A dependent two-verse definition of the first unsupported form; technical scope remains qualified.
Dissolution of five mental grounds, yogic offering and peace-yoga complete the second unsupported form and the classification.
Return to Bhrushundi's worship in Kashi and the stated hearing benefits conclude the narrative.
